'''Joron Tal'vor''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Captain/Legends|captain]] in the [[Republic Navy/Legends|Republic Navy]] during the [[Great Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]].<ref name="Encyclopedia" /> In [[3671 BBY]],<ref name="Timeline" /> Tal'vor married a [[Republic Army]] [[Officer/Legends|officer]] named [[Elin Garza]], becoming her second husband, but Tal'vor was [[Death/Legends|killed]] shortly afterwards while [[Third battle of the Seswenna sector|defending]] the [[Seswenna sector/Legends|Seswenna sector]] from an Imperial offensive.<ref name="Encyclopedia" />

==Behind the scenes==
Joron Tal'vor was mentioned in the [[2012]] reference guide ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic Encyclopedia]]''.<ref name="Encyclopedia" />
